title: Linolenic Acid-Derived Oxylipins Inhibit Aflatoxin Biosynthesis in Aspergillus flavus through Activation of Imizoquin Biosynthesis.
authors: Wu, Shaowen; Zhang, Qunjie; Zhang, Wenyang; Huang, Wenjie; Kong, Qian; Liu, Qinjian; Li, Wenyan; Zou, Xinlu; Liu, Chun-Ming; Yan, Shijuan
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学与分子动力学模拟研究亚麻酸衍生氧化脂素抑制黄曲霉毒素生物合成，涉及蛋白-代谢物互作而非TF-DNA体系，但MD方法可借鉴于蛋白-DNA互作建模。
abstract: Oxylipins play important signaling roles in aflatoxin (AF) biosynthesis in Aspergillus flavus. We previously showed that exogenous supply of autoxidated linolenic acid (AL) inhibited AF biosynthesis in A. flavus via oxylipins, but the molecular mechanism is still unknown. Here, we performed multiomics analyses of A. flavus grown in media with or without AL. Targeted metabolite analyses and quantitative reverse transcription (qRT)-polymerase chain reaction (PCR) showed that the imizoquin (IMQ) biosynthetic pathway was distinctly upregulated in the presence of AL. (13)C-glucose labeling confirmed in parallel that the tricarboxylic acid cycle was also enhanced by AL, consistent with observed increases in mycelial growth. Moreover, we integrated thermal proteome profiling and molecular dynamics simulations to identify a potential receptor of AL; AL was found to interact with a transporter (ImqJ) located in the IMQ gene cluster, primarily through hydrophobic interactions. Further analyses of strains with an IMQ pathway transcription factor overexpressed or knocked out confirmed that this pathway was critical for AL-mediated inhibition of AF biosynthesis. Comparison of 22 assembled A. flavus and Aspergillus oryzae genomes showed that genes involved in the IMQ pathway were positively selected in A. oryzae. Taken together, the results of our study provide novel insights into oxylipin-mediated regulation of AF biosynthesis and suggest potential methods for preventing AF contamination of crops.
abstract_zh: 氧化脂质在黄曲霉（Aspergillus flavus）中黄曲霉毒素（AF）生物合成中发挥重要信号作用。我们先前研究表明，外源供应自氧化亚麻酸（AL）通过氧化脂质抑制黄曲霉中AF生物合成，但其分子机制仍未知。在此，我们对在含或不含AL培养基中生长的黄曲霉进行了多组学分析。靶向代谢物分析和定量逆转录（qRT）-聚合酶链反应（PCR）显示，在AL存在下，咪唑喹啉（IMQ）生物合成途径显著上调。(13)C-葡萄糖标记平行证实，三羧酸循环也因AL而增强，与观察到的菌丝生长增加一致。此外，我们整合了热蛋白质组谱分析和分子动力学模拟，以识别AL的潜在受体；发现AL主要通过疏水相互作用与位于IMQ基因簇中的转运蛋白（ImqJ）相互作用。对IMQ途径转录因子过表达或敲除菌株的进一步分析证实，该途径对AL介导的AF生物合成抑制至关重要。对22个组装的黄曲霉和米曲霉（Aspergillus oryzae）基因组的比较显示，IMQ途径相关基因在米曲霉中受到正选择。综合来看，我们的研究结果为氧化脂质介导的AF生物合成调控提供了新见解，并提出了预防作物AF污染的可能方法。
